newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS gasoline prices extend gains late.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS gasoline prices extend gains late.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS gasoline prices continued to climb in overnight trade, lifted by talk of refinery problems and sentiment that an emphasis on heating oil production would cut into gasoline output.
At 1657 PDT/2357 GMT, NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures climbed 0.28 cent a gallon to 69.50 cents, after settling up 1.06 cents. About 90 lots changed hands, out of a total of 150.
Front-month crude oil reversed its daytime fall and rose on technical buying, a trader said, hitting $24.70 a barrel, 19 cents over the settle. Roughly 600 lots traded in December and 1,080 overall.
"It looks like people are trying to push December (crude) back to where (November) had been," a ACCESS overnight trader said.

November heating oil, which goes off the board October 31, hit 71 cents gallon on ACCESS, up 0.51 cent a gallon from the settle as 50 lots traded in the nearby month. Seventy-three lots traded in all months.
